title: FB-028 replay early Tauri lifecycle events
summary: Fix FR-028 by preserving and replaying the latest Tauri backend lifecycle event after the WebView app listener is registered.
reason: Worker findings showed backend lifecycle events emitted during async WebView startup could be dispatched before app.js registered its event listener.
behavior_before: A Tauri backend lifecycle event dispatched before app.js attached the WebView listener was lost.
behavior_after: The Tauri lifecycle bridge retains the latest event and app.js replays it immediately after listener registration.
manual_validation: Bundled Python with PYTHONPATH=src: python -m unittest tests.webview.test_webview_browser_lifecycle_smoke -q passed.
Bundled Python with PYTHONPATH=src: python -m unittest tests.webview.test_webview_tauri_lifecycle_bridge tests.webview.test_webview_frontend_mutation_boundary -q passed.
rollback_plan: Restore direct dispatch-only lifecycle bridge behavior and remove the app.js replay call, then rerun WebView lifecycle validation.
notes: Tauri lifecycle boundary only; no backend mutation or filesystem mutation policy changes.
